main.description: The net.ratat.graph.follow records an actor holds, newest first, read from the local index. [public]

page.description: Page number for numbered paging, which is what the web's follow list uses. Give page or cursor, not both.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page; omit for the first page.
Absent when the last page has been served.

page.description: The page actually served, which is the last one when paging ran out first.

total.description: How many follows the index holds for this actor. Present when paged, since numbered paging is what needs a total.

indexed.description: Whether the index has walked this actor's follow records at least once. False means the answer may be short, and a caller holding the repo should read it directly; asking marks the actor for a walk, so a later call answers fully.

uri.description: The follow record's at-uri; delete it to unfollow.

handle.description: The followed account's handle from the index snapshot; absent when the index has not resolved one yet, in which case callers fall back to the DID.

avatar.description: CDN URL, not a blob ref.
